sloka: कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य युधाजित्केकयो नृपः ।स्वगुरुं प्रेषयामास राघवाय महात्मने ।गार्ग्यमङ्गिरसः पुत्रं ब्रह्मर्षिममितप्रभम् ।। ७.१००.१ ॥
transliteration: kasyacittvatha kālasya yudhājitkekayo nṛpaḥ ।svaguruṁ preṣayāmāsa rāghavāya mahātmane ।gārgyamaṅgirasaḥ putraṁ brahmarṣimamitaprabham ।। 7.100.1 ॥

translations.english: Then, after some time, King Yudhājit of Kekaya sent his own preceptor, Gārgya, the son of Angiras, a Brahmarshi of immeasurable splendor, to the great-souled Rama.
